headline: Gold and Silver ETFs remain in long-term uptrend, says technical analyst
hook: Long-term bull trend intact for precious metals

modes.bear: Recent sharp sell-offs highlight ongoing volatility and near-term downside risk in commodity markets.
modes.bull: Multi-year technical chart patterns indicate long-term structural momentum for precious metal ETFs remains intact.
modes.simple: A chart analyst says recent price drops in Gold and Silver ETFs haven't broken their long-term upward trend.

summary: Nippon India ETF Gold BeES and Nippon India Silver ETF remain in a structural multi-year uptrend despite recent price pullbacks. Drumil Vithlani, Senior Technical Research Analyst at Tiny Epic, noted that technical chart patterns for both precious metal funds remain positive. The view suggests recent market sell-offs represent short-term corrections rather than a broader trend reversal for Indian investors holding gold and silver assets.
why_it_matters: Recent dips in gold and silver ETFs may not signal a trend reversal.

headline: Major Gold ETFs fall up to 2.3% on Dhanteras
hook: Gold ETFs dip on auspicious Dhanteras day
summary: Major Indian Gold ETFs including Nippon India, Tata, and ICICI Prudential saw a decline of up to 2.3% during the Dhanteras trading session. This price correction occurred despite the traditional surge in gold demand during the festive period. The drop in ETF values directly tracks the movement of underlying physical gold prices in the domestic market. Retail investors who purchased gold digitally today benefited from lower prices compared to previous sessions.
whats_next: Global gold price trends and US Fed commentary
why_it_matters: Lower entry prices for gold buyers this festive season
winners_losers: New buyers gain / existing holders hurt
